items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 July 2026 4:14am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 28 July 2026 at 4:10am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind warning.


##Synopsis##

Low to the northwest of Ireland. High over northern France, transferring eastwards.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, occasionally increasing 6 in the southeast of the area this morning, then increasing more generally 5 or 6 for a while late afternoon and this evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Patchy outbreaks of light rain or drizzle, becoming mainly fair this morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in places


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, soon decreasing 3 or 4 occasional 5, veering west or northwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate at first, becoming mostly slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, then outbreaks of rain slowly spreading from the northwest, becoming mostly fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate.
